card.summary: 10 GB total per account: 100 MB per file, 1,000 MB per uploader, 10 uploaders per account = 10 GB. Free, and the terms state '当サイトが金銭を要求することは一切ありません'.

record.provider: uploader.jp / getuploader.com (アップローダーレンタル)

free_tier.stated: 10 GB total per account: 100 MB per file, 1,000 MB per uploader, 10 uploaders per account = 10 GB. Free, and the terms state '当サイトが金銭を要求することは一切ありません'.

retention.stated: 1 GB per uploader, 10 GB per account. No retention limit (persistent hosting, unlike the transfer services), which is the one thing it does better than Gigafile.

egress.terms: No meter; ad-supported on download pages.

record.tooling: Per-uploader web forms with no API. Community-maintained link lists exist (w.atwiki.jp/vbmaker, uploaders.jp).
record.chaining: 10 uploaders x 1 GB inside one account; multiple accounts would be needed to pass 500 GB, and 100 MB per file is the hard wall. This cannot hold bulk data of any kind.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MB. 1 GB per uploader, 10 GB per account. No retention limit (persistent hosting, unlike the transfer services), which is the one thing it does better than Gigafile.
record.reliability_note: Genuinely old and genuinely alive. A sample uploader showed files posted the previous day in Sept 2026, while the official site's own copy still says 2017. Default configuration makes every upload publicly listable and search-indexable.

evidence.proved: 'アップローダーまで 1 アカウント あたり MBまで' (Live counter), '完全無料'
